name: std::unordered_set<Key,Hash,KeyEqual,Allocator>::max_load_factor
intro:
Manages the maximum load factor (number of elements per bucket). The container automatically increases the number of buckets if the load factor exceeds this threshold.

1) Returns current maximum load factor.

2) Sets the maximum load factor to ml.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
ml

 -

 new maximum load factor setting

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Insert keys 2, 3, and 4, then inspect the bucket holding key 2. Bucket counts and iteration order are implementation-dependent.
